note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. The symbolic chains are abstract stand-ins, not real fingerprint features or a method; a bridge only says that two supplied symbols are the same. The final state is drawn exactly as supplied ('compared' or 'pending'); nothing is said about identity, reliability, admissibility or any outcome. Times are illustrative and imply no time limit. Editable brief fields: items, custodians, timestamps, records, actorLabels, objectLabels, actionProgress, annotations, finalState (plus segments, cards, matchLabels).
